name: pit-mcp-oauth-shim
description: Shared OAuth discovery + authorize/register/callback/token-redirect-fixup shim for PrecisionIT Entra-gated MCP gateways. mountOAuthShim() for express apps, mountOAuthShimRaw() for hand-rolled routers; clientId/clientSecret may be a string or an async Key-Vault resolver; callbackPath is overridable for gateways that already own /oauth/callback for a second OAuth flow. The host gateway keeps its own inbound JWT validation and write-role gate untouched.
